sources.quality_notes: Distinct passage from registered juan2 and juan5; seven birth-branch groups in Huangdi Doutu citation, no ancient target folio binding.

sources.title: 《七曜攘災決》T1308 SAT傳文
sources.quality_notes: Read p0427c08–p0428a15 and p0452a25–b21. Changbao and later Japanese dates adjacent, not dates of individual table; no original folio.

sources.title: 《文殊師利菩薩及諸仙所説吉凶時日善惡宿曜經》K1367卷上
sources.quality_notes: Opening chapter distinguishes 27 mansions and 12 zodiacal divisions, 9 mansion quarters per sign; not twelve natal life domains. Exact T1299 original folio and recension relationship unbound.

sources.title: Varāhamihira Bṛhajjātaka GRETIL 2020 text
sources.provider: Göttingen Register of Electronic Texts in Indian Languages
sources.quality_notes: BJ_01.15–16, 2020-07-31 TEI transformation, header references 1979 second edition. Glosses provisional; no ancient manuscript or regional South Indian exclusive evidence.

sources.title: Jeffrey Kotyk 2018 The Sinicization of Indo-Iranian Astrology in Medieval China
sources.quality_notes: Different publication from registered Japan Sukuyo 2018 article; previous p26–28 review and fresh p28 PDF index29 screenshot. Author distinguishes ascendant calculation and Chinese double-hour method; reconstructed figures and arguments secondary.
